classification.difficultyReason: Use the central angle of a regular octagon and identify the required reflex angle.

content.prompt: Work out the value of $a$ in this regular octagon.

spec.description: Octagon with horizontal top and bottom sides, vertical left and right sides, single equality ticks on all outer edges, and double ticks on radii to adjacent upper-right vertices. A marked centre and reflex arc labelled a degrees are retained. Decorative blue source lines become house black; no shading.
spec.mathematics: Adjacent radii of a regular octagon enclose 45 degrees. The required reflex angle is 315 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Question shows the centre, equal-length marks and a degrees, without the 45-degree or 315-degree answers.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle inside the triangle at the centre of the regular octagon.
$$\begin{aligned}\theta&=\frac{360^\circ}{8}\\\theta&=45^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
The marked angle is reflex:
$$\begin{aligned}a&=360-45\\a&=315.\end{aligned}$$
